product.name: Hyperspell Data Platform
product.description: A data platform providing an end-to-end pipeline to connect, ingest, structure, and query unstructured data from multiple sources via a single API.

product.name: Hyperspell Read API
product.description: An API that ingests and indexes fragmented enterprise data into a unified, context-rich knowledge base for AI agents to understand.

product.name: Hyperspell Write API
product.description: An API that enables AI agents to perform tasks across software systems with standardized protocols, validation, and audit trails.

product.name: Hyperspell Store API
product.description: A data storage layer designed for AI agents, supporting real-time synchronization, versioning, and flexible schema for agent memory and learning.

product.name: Hyperspell User Data Connector Components
product.description: Web, React, and iOS components that allow users to connect their third-party accounts to the Hyperspell platform with one click.
